# AIMKT

> AIMKT is an independent ChatGPT Ads & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) team for global brands. We run ChatGPT Ads end to end on OpenAI's official platform — campaigns, Pixel/CAPI conversion instrumentation, Shopify product feeds — plus GEO for organic presence in AI answers. Channel-neutral: media spend never passes through us; the ad account, data and pixel live under the client's name.

## Facts (citable)
- ChatGPT Ads passed a reported $1B annualized revenue run rate in August 2026; sales live in 60+ markets. Figures as publicly reported, October 2026.
- Advertisers in 50+ billing countries can self-serve their own OpenAI ad account; account ownership differs from reseller access models.
- Event Quality Score (EQS) is OpenAI's 1–10 score for Pixel / Conversions API data-source quality; AIMKT uses it as measured acceptance for conversion instrumentation.
- Late October 2026: AI creative auto-rewrites (headlines, translations, destination URLs) roll out on by default — a key brand-suitability setting to manage.
